name: Image Style Warmer
description: Create image styles of an image on upload or via queue worker.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 The Image Style Warmer module provides options to create image styles during upload or

via queue worker. So configured image derivates already exists when they are requested.

 
 Pre-generate configured image styles on image upload or crop change. 
 Pre-generate configured image styles via queue worker. 
 
 Installation 
 Versions 8.x-1.x : Install as usual, see the official documentation for further information.

 Configuration 
 
 Go to Manage > Configuration > Development > Performance > Image Style Warmer . 
 Select image styles which should be created during upload. 
 Select image styles which should be created via queue worker. 
 Save Image Style Warmer settings. 
 Enable queue worker via drush queue-run image_style_warmer_pregenerator . 
 
 Try on simplytest.me 

 Requirements 
 Following Drupal core modules are required to use Image Style Warmer module.

 
 drupal/file core module 
 drupal/image core module
